appraisal_events.evidence: "Aimé, avec un éclat modeste, dégageait...le romanesque" and "il se distinguait au milieu de la foule des autres serviteurs", who by contrast "offraient des types extraordinairement laids"; "Il avait un air intelligent, énergique, mais respectueux."
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator singles Aimé out as distinctive and aesthetically striking against the ugly, hypocritical-looking older waiters, and separately notes his intelligent, energetic, respectful bearing, giving him a distinct local elevation independent of Saint-Loup's jealousy plot.

status_effects.explanation: Aimé is locally elevated by the narrator's admiring description of his distinctive looks and competent, respectful manner, set apart from the other servers.
